# aiLedger

aiLedger is building a shared, verifiable record of evidence, decisions and discoveries, so people and AI can build on each other’s work.

Its open-source, append-only record is a foundation for collective intelligence. Alongside it, aiDNA is an open context standard for carrying understanding between efforts.

The company’s scientific ambitions include AI-assisted molecular discovery, understanding undiagnosed rare disease, preserving biological and climate data, and environmental investigation. These are ambitions, not claims of delivered clinical or environmental outcomes.

Connecting what we know. Changing what comes next.

Source: https://github.com/ailedger-dev/ailedger
